checks.reason: Checked the prespecified primary endpoint, hazard ratio, interval estimate, and event rates rather than relying on significance language alone.
Randomization directly supports the treatment-target contrast within the enrolled population; transfer beyond eligibility is kept separate.
The primary benefit claim is linked to the prespecified composite outcome and its reported event counts.
Checked the mortality estimate and confidence interval as a distinct endpoint rather than inferring it from the primary composite.
Mortality is compared under the randomized target assignment, preserving the trial-level causal contrast.
The mortality claim uses the reported death counts and hazard ratio, not the primary endpoint as a proxy.
Checked adverse-event categories as observed trial outcomes and did not collapse all harms into a single narrative label.
Harms are interpreted within the same randomized treatment strategy and follow-up.
The harm claim is tied to the serious-adverse-event analysis rather than inferred from treatment intensity.
